title: Standard of proof.
bodyText: Except as may be otherwise expressly provided, the civil causes of action in this part shall be proved by a preponderance of the evidence.
bodyHtml: [§712-1271.5]  Standard of proof.  Except as may be otherwise expressly provided, the civil causes of action in this part shall be proved by a preponderance of the evidence. [L 2005, c 123, pt of §1]
